holidays.name: Toadling New Sprout
holidays.description: New caps sprout, Toad Town census
holidays.longDescription: Toadling New Sprout is observed on day 1 of month 1 in the Mushroom Folk Calendar. It is classified as a festival and is associated with New caps sprout, Toad Town census . Communities use the occasion to preserve local memory, reinforce shared identity, and mark the passage of the calendar year. Practices vary by region and faction, so this observance may carry different political or religious meaning across the wider world.
